event.title: An Unreasonable Commitment to the Square
event.description: Visit Kelsey Barton’s free exhibition An Unreasonable Commitment to the Square at 4Most Gallery & Studio. Explore ceramic works built from repeated square forms and the relationship between structure, repetition, and clay. The exhibit runs October 12–23, 2026. The gallery is closed Sunday; this quest’s next check-in window is Monday, October 19, noon–5 PM Eastern. Earn 25 XP once per person for the entire exhibit, even if the board is refreshed later.
